classification_reason: Every probe got a ranked, reasoned list, but the product's connection surface (`related`) returns no notes for a note; useful neighbours needed a scripted 2-hop plus searches, and most cross-course and Garden/inbox connections came only from my own reading.

consumer.goal: For each of the 20 canon probe notes, list what else the learner has that she should read next to it, best first, with reasons.
consumer.first_action: Ran `los related` on all 20 probe notes.
commands: git reset --hard; git clean -fd (world reset, fresh)
confusions: `related NOTE_ID` never returns another note: for all 20 probes it returned only the note's own concepts, sources and (sometimes) workspace. Finding neighbouring notes required a manual second hop (`related` on each concept/source/workspace) which I scripted.
Second-hop via a course-slides source returns every note citing the slides (up to ~20), i.e. topical but unranked; via a shared concept it is sharper but most cross-domain links share no concept.
No command reaches Garden seeds or inbox captures, so candidates of those kinds come from reading.
For C14 (spaced repetition) the product surfaced nothing at all; every candidate is from reading.
corrective_steps: Scripted a 2-hop traversal over `related` (hop2.py in my scratchpad) and ~27 thematic searches (metadata + --content) to generate product candidates.
Ranked and explained the candidates from my full reading of the corpus done in S02.
consumer.outcome: 20 ranked connection lists (connections.jsonl, phase canon), 5–10 targets each, each with reason, evidence and whether a product command or my reading surfaced it. Of 177 listed targets, 88 were surfaced by a product command (mostly 2-hop related or search) and 89 came only from my reading — including most cross-course links (NB ↔ selectivity independence, WAL ↔ event sourcing and the Garden log seed, MAP ↔ ridge, low-rank ↔ matrix factorization).

internal.projection_activity: All reads served from the same snapshot (sha256:82bcffb7…).

friction.description: No note-to-note connection query: `related` on a note returns only its own concept/source/workspace ids. There is no 'notes like this', no similarity over bodies, and no traversal of concept relations to reach notes.

Cross-domain connections (the ones a learner most needs) are invisible to every product surface because notes on different courses rarely share a concept id and the 28 concept relations are all intra-domain.
friction.cost: relied on a full-corpus read (~35k tokens, done in S02)

friction.description: Garden seeds and inbox captures are outside search/related; they appear only in the Nebula (Garden) or not at all (inbox).

product_commands_that_produced_candidate: los related (1 hop: 0 notes for 18/20 probes; 2-hop over concept/source/workspace ids)
scenario_record.candidates_added_by_reading: 89 of 177 targets; all Garden/inbox targets; all C14 targets; the top-ranked target for C02, C06(2nd), C07(2nd), C10, C19, C20.

uncertainties: Source attribution records which product command could surface a candidate; the ranking and every reason are mine and were informed by the full reading done in S02, so product-attributed candidates were not found 'blind' by the product alone.
